description: This file contains implementation for 2D and 3D grid sampling operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It includes functions to perform grid sampling, handle different padding and interpolation modes, and interface with Metal compute shaders.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: A wrapper class for caching Metal Performance Shaders graphs used during grid sampling to avoid recompilation.

methods.name: grid_sampler_2d_mps_impl
methods.description: Core implementation for 2D grid sampling on MPS backend, setting up and executing Metal graphs based on input parameters.

methods.name: grid_sampler_template
methods.description: Template function handling both 2D and 3D grid sampling operations, validating inputs, setting up output tensors, and dispatching GPU kernels.

methods.name: grid_sampler_2d_mps
methods.description: Public API function wrapping the 2D grid sampling operation for MPS.

methods.name: grid_sampler_3d_mps
methods.description: Public API function wrapping the 3D grid sampling operation for MPS.
